critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind safelist approach works but is brittle — any future role string must be manually added. Consider a centralized role->class map (e.g., roleConfig.js) exported from RoleLayout to avoid drift.
stat-card CSS uses --accent-raw for border-left which comes from parent .role-* class — works but tightly couples stat-card location to inside a RoleLayout. Document this contract.

Two separate users exist with mobile=7777777777 (one 'resident' and one 'sub_admin'). Login API role_priority picks sub_admin first so works, but duplicate-mobile is a latent data-integrity risk — consider a unique index on (mobile, role) or (mobile) with soft-delete.
